errors.evidence: The y-axis categories are not sorted in descending order. For example, the category '23' appears above '15', and '13' appears below '15'.
The bar corresponding to the y-axis label '5' has a value of 39, not 32. The value 32 corresponds to an unlabeled bar (likely for title length 6).
The bar corresponding to the y-axis label '11' has a value of 4, not 5. The value 5 corresponds to an unlabeled bar (likely for title length 10).
The bar corresponding to the y-axis label '13' has a value of 2, not 4. The value 4 corresponds to an unlabeled bar (likely for title length 12).
The bar corresponding to the y-axis label '15' has a value of 1, not 4. The value 4 corresponds to the bar for title length 11.
The description omits several bars that are clearly visible in the chart but do not have explicit y-axis labels. These include bars with values 38, 32, 13, 5, 4, and 1.

The description states the unit for the x-axis is '首' (poems), but this is not explicitly written on the axis. The axis label is '《唐诗三百首》诗歌数量' (Number of poems in 'Three Hundred Tang Poems'), from which '首' is inferred. While a reasonable inference, it's not explicitly stated as a unit on the axis itself.
